comments.author: Sister Fister
comments.body_html:
Ah hell, I’ve been meaning to comment on here, but thanks heaps Jehree for unintentionally putting the task on yourself and nailing it. I was doing something similar to this back in the days of 0.13, the hard way, and never ended up finishing it, so it’s flipping awesome to see someone do a proper crack at it in more of a patching method, while keeping it sensible and on point.

The only core change I would make, asides from making post-patch compatibility support for mods, but eh, OOS, is the two 40mm being on the list, and altered to something like So40 and 40NT, as shorties for 40 mm VOGs and the famous 40x46mm respectively.

A few personalisations I’ve made and would recommend to others, are…

  • Changing 308 to 762N or N762 (no one from what I’ve noticed really uses the American 308 designation anymore, especially in bigger tactical games, but I’m not that social with other gun nuts or CoD/BF mainstreamers), 7.62x39 to 762S (to represent the commoner designation of it being Soviet era intermediatery ammo), and keeping 762R (’cause well, makes sense compared to the others =P). It slows down instinctive reactions, but god, does it help a lot having the style of round present and still remaining to Euro standards like the rest of the ammo short names tend to be, especially when compared to trying to re-learn American diameter measurements variants when 7.62x51mm Euro measurements are already super normalised in Tarkov. Alternatively, they could be Sx39, Nx51, and x54R.
  • Cut down the Noslr to just UNos (or Nslr), it’s probably more common for people to call it Nosler, but frankly I call it the full name.
  • T-45M1, slim to just T45M or even 45M1, preferably 45M1 to be different from T46M. Those two are the only odd 762 rounds out that use 5 rather than 4 or less, which easily makes them the first ones to report being too long with the above change happens.
  • Change .50 Action Express’ calibre handle, to 50AE, which furthers itself from the .50 BMG.
  • 23x75mm to 4ga. From what I’ve read, it’s approximately a 4ga round in Euro standard, which would suit the 12ga and 20ga rounds a lot more than the actual measurements Tarkov uses, which frankly makes it come off as more like a grenade launcher round or a very big bullet to those with less knowledge.
  • If modders or devs add more .300 cali rounds that aren’t specifically BLK and incompatible, change the 300 to BLK instead, although personally I haven’t done this (I think the WTT mods or maybe Epic or Eyuk’s mods have non BLK standard .300 too, which is like, ouchie mah braino).

Also I’ve personally changed Grizzly to just Grzz (personal pref), Devastator to Dvst (better syncope), Copper to Cppr (same), M80A1 to 80A1 (“A1” can mean a lotta different rounds, 855A1, 856A1, etc), Zvezda to Flash, Dual Sabot to DSbt (flows better), AP SX->SXAP (and most 4.6 rounds got changed to have SX as a prefix, but not the calibre itself (in case any mod adds non-SX branded 4.6 ammo), thus “4.6 SXAP” | SXFMJ, SXAct, SXSub, SXJSP, they had extra letters avaliable, so hell yeah), SSA AP->“SSAAP” and (jokingly) Warmage from War to Mage, because magic doesn’t exist, and it’s always been a trash round for me when doing leg meta, but I swear leg meta is just a load of trash outside the MP7 anyway, /LeShrug.

Anyway, that’s my drivel for anyone that might want to make more comprehensive updates to the config files for better clarity or some more sensibility in the naming schemes. If you’ve read through all of this, thanks for giving me the time, and if you incorporate any of these changes Jehree, well, thanks.
